title: Inflammatory Bowel Diseases
tocPath: APPROACH TO PATIENTS WITH EMERGENCY CONDITIONS

blocks.text: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is an idiopathic disease involving an immune reaction of the body to its own intestinal tract. The 2 major types of IBD are ulcerative colitis (UC) and Crohn’s disease (CD). Pathologically, ulcerative colitis is limited to the colon while Crohn’s disease can involve any segment of the gastrointestinal (GI) tract from the mouth to the anus.
